meta.status: PROVISIONAL — UNVERIFIED ESTIMATES, NOT YET COMPUTED FROM A CORPUS
meta.provenance_warning: The affinity_score values in this file are DIRECTIONAL ESTIMATES from bartender/model knowledge. They were NOT computed from recipe co-occurrence data. Do not present them as sourced measurements. A reproducible pipeline that derives real scores from a food-recipe corpus is the agreed next step (see scripts/ — pending a corpus; the sandbox network is restricted and no food-recipe dataset is committed yet).
meta.intended_methodology: Target: affinity_score = a normalized ingredient co-occurrence signal (e.g. NPMI or log-prevalence) computed from a real food-recipe corpus, mirroring how data/tradition.json is built from cocktail recipes. Ahn et al. 2011 (Scientific Reports 1:196) is the methodological model, NOT the source of the current numbers.
directional_inspiration: Ahn et al. 2011, 'Flavor network and the principles of food pairing' — method only.
Page & Dornenburg 2008, 'The Flavor Bible' — expert chef pairing consensus.
CSIRO / Orana Foundation native-ingredient work — cited as background reading, NOT verified per-pair; native pairing notes need a real source check at Part B.
meta.compound_bridge_note: Where the engine attaches shared_compounds + harmony to a pair, THAT part is real: it is computed live from Cobber's curated aroma DB. Note Cobber curates only a few signature compounds per ingredient, so 'no shared compound' here means 'no SIGNATURE overlap', not 'no molecule in common' (FlavorDB's full catalog shows broad trace overlap).
